subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should Gateway-owned cron declarations remain part of the experimental core Claws lifecycle and be landed only as the ordered lifecycle/export stack, rather than as an independently mergeable scheduler feature?
rationale: The implementation is a new durable core product surface, not a repair to an established behavior; maintainers must choose the experimental Claws scope and its merge sequencing.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core feature
options.body: Keep this PR in the Claws stack, require real-Gateway proof, and merge only after the prerequisite lifecycle/export work is accepted.

options.title: Narrow or defer the scheduler slice
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want durable scheduler ownership in the initial experimental Claws contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged core feature
recommendation.body: Keep this PR in the Claws stack, require real-Gateway proof, and merge only after the prerequisite lifecycle/export work is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick’s review established the canonical deletion and scheduler-durability boundary and he is assigned to the PR.
